_comment: Stone Guardian — first boss, 'guardian' brain. Wakes at aggro_range (music → boss), walks toward the player between attacks, then rolls weights: SLAM (tell → feet hitbox slam_size, damage 2, plus a shockwave along the floor each side), VOLLEY (tell → throw_count arcing rocks lobbed at the player's feet, spread rock_spread px), CHARGE (tell → runs at charge_speed with a charge_box hitbox, damage 2, until a wall/ledge/charge_max_time, then stunned charge_stun — its window). Phase 2 at phase2_frac HP: tells × tell_mult_p2, volley throws throw_count_p2. 40 HP = forty 1-damage sword hits; hurt_stun 0 / resist 1 means hits never stagger it. Sets defeat_flag on death and never respawns in that save. Numbers in px, px/s, seconds.
